headline: Mirza Fakhrul says local polls likely by year-end or early next year
summary: The BNP Secretary General stated that local government elections are expected to be held by the end of this year or the beginning of next year.
details: BNP Secretary General Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir has indicated that local government elections in Bangladesh are likely to take place by the end of 2024 or early 2025.
caption:
Local government elections could be coming soon. BNP's Mirza Fakhrul suggests a timeline for the polls.

BNP Secretary General Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir has indicated that local government elections in Bangladesh are likely to take place by the end of 2024 or early 2025.

Source: Somoy News, Dhaka Tribune

headline_marked: Govt takes [[reformative steps to stop irregularities]] in housing sector: PM
headline: Govt takes reformative steps to stop irregularities in housing sector: PM
summary: Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina announced that the government is implementing measures to ensure transparency and curb malpractice within the real estate and housing industry.
details: Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina has stated that the government has taken several reformative steps to prevent irregularities in the housing sector.
The Prime Minister emphasized the need for transparency and accountability to protect homebuyers from fraud and mismanagement.
These measures are aimed at streamlining the real estate process and ensuring that developers adhere to legal and ethical standards.
The government intends to create a more regulated environment to boost confidence among citizens investing in housing projects.
caption:
Stopping housing fraud: The government is implementing new reforms to clean up the real estate sector.

Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina has stated that the government has taken several reformative steps to prevent irregularities in the housing sector.

The Prime Minister emphasized the need for transparency and accountability to protect homebuyers from fraud and mismanagement.

These measures are aimed at streamlining the real estate process and ensuring that developers adhere to legal and ethical standards.

The government intends to create a more regulated environment to boost confidence among citizens investing in housing projects.

#Bangladesh #HousingSector #RealEstate #Governance #SheikhHasina #News

Source: Somoy News
